title: Fix cache:pr-updated wire format mismatch (snake_case vs camelCase)
description: Test in src-tauri/src/events.rs verifies PrUpdated serializes head_ref_oid in snake_case, but src/App.tsx (line ~221) reads ev.payload.headRefOid as camelCase. This means the head-change detection in the cache:pr-updated handler always treats every event as a head change (or never triggers, depending on the code path). Fix: add #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] to PrUpdated in src-tauri/src/events.rs (and check the other event structs for the same issue), then update the test.

title: Comprehensive test coverage across codebase
description: Build out unit and functional tests for both the React/TS frontend and Rust/Tauri backend until coverage is satisfactory. Frontend: anchors.ts (existing), api.ts, types.ts, updater.ts, ThreadCard, MarginRail, App. Backend: db.rs, github.rs, sync.rs, events.rs, lib.rs commands. Set up test runners as needed (bun:test for frontend, cargo test for backend).
close_reason: Added 222 tests (157 frontend + 65 net new backend). Frontend: utils.ts pure helpers (relativeTime/activityFreshness/truncate/threadsEqual/buildThreadsByLine/unresolvedCountsByFile/sortFilesByUnresolved/pickInitialFile/filterPRs/findLatestCollaboratorActivity), api.ts wrappers, updater.ts silent+interactive, ThreadCard rendering+interactions+delete arm-then-confirm, MarginRail placement+interactions, App startup+open-PR+Cmd+R+sidebar+error. Backend: db.rs all optimistic+outbox flows, github.rs split_repo+missing_scopes+errors, sync.rs backoff+constants, events.rs wire format. Filed prose-1sx for a wire format mismatch caught while testing.

title: Cmd+F search across active PR's file content and comments
description: When a PR is selected, Cmd+F should open an in-app search bar that matches against (a) the rendered prose of the active file and (b) all comment bodies in every thread on that PR (across all files, not just the active one). Results should be navigable (Enter / Shift+Enter for next/prev), highlight matches inline in the prose, and surface comment hits in a results list that jumps to the relevant thread when clicked. Suppress the default webview Find UI - we own this UX.
